'''Horned melon''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop|garden plant]]. They can be planted in all seasons and the fruit is edible raw or [[cooking|cooked]].

It is one of the few crops whose fruit uses a ☼ instead of a %.

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[preferences|like]] horned melon vines for their ''fruit''.
